name: Attorney-Client Privilege Header/Footer
description: Detects privilege and confidentiality markers: ATTORNEY-CLIENT PRIVILEGED, WORK PRODUCT, PRIVILEGED AND CONFIDENTIAL, etc. Per ABA Model Rule 1.6, content bearing these markers relates to the representation and must not be transmitted to external AI systems without attorney review.

effect.message: Privilege or work-product marker detected and redacted. The presence of this marker signals potential attorney-client privileged or work-product protected material. This marker alone does not determine privilege, but it is a strong indicator that the document requires attorney review before submission to any external AI system.
